purpose: #397 route check (not a Playable confirmation): bloody-roar-extreme.route replay 2, fast START/A menu phase
title: 48550001-Bloody_Roar_Extreme.xiso.iso
route:
# Bloody Roar: Extreme (48550001), Nova. Built from the generic survey
# 1790921692-titleroutes-1082566 (lane.titleroutes session 63, reviewed
# session 64; re-read by lane.titleroutes2 session 1, 2026-10-02). Read
# from its route-frames, not guessed:
#   booted (004716): the intro movie.
#   cycle 1 (004722 START / 004728 A): "PRESS START" title, then black.
#   cycle 2 (004734 / 004740): black, then the attract DEMONSTRATION fight.
#   cycle 3 (004746 START / 004752 A): the demo again, then the title.
#   cycle 4 (004758 START / 004803 A): "Create BLOODY ROAR extreme save
#     data? YES / NO" (NO lit); A answers it and the main menu shows.
#   cycle 5 (004810 START / 004816 A): ARCADE -> Select your character.
#   cycle 6 (004822 START / 004828 A): Yugo picked; the stage / time /
#     rounds card.
#   cycle 7 (004833 START / 004840 A): the stage intro, then "STAGE 1".
#   cycle 8 (004846 START / 004852 A): ROUND 1 / GET READY: a live fight,
#     Yugo vs Shina.
#   cycles 9-14: START opens PAUSE (RESUME lit) and A resumes it; the
#     round timer runs 60 -> 44 across the window.
# The on-screen FPS counter reads 10-11 in the fight: a real slowdown
# (#397), not a route artifact. At that speed one 60 s round outlasts the
# whole window, so the loop never meets a KO or continue screen; its A
# press would also take one.
# So: 10 START/A cycles (8 reached the fight; the last 2 are a guard
# against a slower attract cycle, and pause + resume if the fight came on
# time), mark, then a fight loop with no START.
# Replay 1 (1790939919-titleroutes2-1446231, ref 282a5af148): NEVER LEFT
# THE ATTRACT LOOP. Each frame is shot 5 s after its press, so: the title
# came up, A landed on it, it timed out to black and a DEMONSTRATION fight,
# and the next START (11 s after the last) only brought the title back --
# six times over, then the title for the rest of the window. The title
# takes START only for a few seconds before it times out, and an 11 s
# cycle kept missing that window; the survey's cycle 4 hit it by luck of
# phase. So the menu phase is now START/A pairs 1.2 s apart for ~110 s
# (the survey's title -> fight took ~50 s): START passes the title, the
# save prompt (NO lit), the main menu (ARCADE lit), character select and
# the cards; in the fight each pair is pause + RESUME (A), so the phase
# always ends unpaused. A frame every 4 pairs.
wait 20
shot boot20
wait 20
shot boot40
wait 20
shot booted
repeat 12 {
    repeat 4 {
        press START
        wait 1.2
        press A
        wait 1.2
    }
    shot menu
}
wait 2
shot pre-mark
mark gameplay               # CHECK: the fight, both health bars, no PAUSE panel
repeat forever {
    repeat 4 {
        axis LX max
        wait 0.6
        press X
        wait 0.3
        press Y
        wait 0.3
        press X
        wait 0.3
        axis LX mid
        press B
        wait 0.3
        press A
        wait 0.3
        axis LX min
        wait 0.4
        axis LX mid
        wait 0.3
    }
    shot play
}
